children.text: Financial Assistance:
The applicant can avail a term loan for viable income-generating schemes, including sanitation-related activities.
The maximum project cost covered under the scheme is ₹15,00,000/-.
The General Term Loan can be provided up to a maximum of 90% of the unit
Loan Amount
Interest Rate Chargeable to SCA
Interest Rate Chargeable to Beneficiary
4.5% per annum
9% per annum
Promoter’s Contribution:
Promoter’s contribution is not insisted upon for projects costing up to ₹2,00,000/-.
For projects costing more than ₹2,00,000/-, the minimum promoter’s contribution required from the beneficiary is 5%.
The SCA is required to provide a 5% contribution.
The remaining 10% share of the unit cost is provided by SCAs through a loan, subsidy, promoter’s contribution, or any other available source of funds.
Repayment Period:
The repayment period is up to 10 years.
The repayment period starts after an implementation period of 4 months and a moratorium period of 6 months.
The repayment period is calculated from the date of disbursement of the loan.
The repayment period depends on the viability/profitability and repayment capacity of the unit.
Mode of Disbursement:
Term loans are extended through:
State Channelising Agencies (SCAs)
Regional Rural Banks (RRBs)
Nationalised Banks

schemeContent.briefDescription: A general term loan scheme by the Ministry of Social justice and Empowerment for Safai Karamchari, Manual Scavengers, and their dependants aged 18 years and above.

children.text: The scheme "Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - General Term Loan" has been launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. Under this scheme, term loans are extended through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs), Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), and Nationalised Banks to the target group. Under this scheme, assistance is provided for any viable income-generating schemes, including sanitation-related activities, with a maximum project cost of ₹ 15.00 lac.

children.text: Safai Karamcharis (including Wastepickers), Manual Scavengers and their dependants constitute the target group.

schemeDefinitions.definitions_md: Safai Karamcharis (including Wastepickers), Manual Scavengers and their dependants constitute the target group.
schemeDefinitions.name: Target group

children.text: “Safai Karamchari” means a person, including his/her dependants, engaged in or employed for any sanitation work and includes waste pickers, but excludes domestic worker and manual scavengers.

schemeDefinitions.definitions_md: “Safai Karamchari” means a person, including his/her dependants, engaged in or employed for any sanitation work and includes waste pickers, but excludes domestic worker and manual scavengers.
schemeDefinitions.name: Safai Karamchari

children.text: A person engaged or employed by an individual or a local authority or an agency or a contractor for manually cleaning, carrying, disposing of, or otherwise handling in any manner, human excreta in an insanitary latrine or in an open drain or pit into which the human excreta from the insanitary latrines is disposed of, or on railway track or in such other spaces or premises, as the Central Government or a State Government may notify, before the excreta fully decomposes in such a manner as may be prescribed, and the expression ‘’Manual Scavenging” shall be construed accordingly and a) “engaged or employed’’ means being engaged or employed on a regular or contract basis; b) a person engaged or employed to clean excreta with the help of such devices and using such protective gear, as the Central Government may notify in this behalf, shall not be deemed to be a ‘manual scavenger’.

children.text: “Dependant” in relation to a Safai Karamcharis (including Wastepickers), Manual Scavengers includes a member of his family, who is dependent on him/her and has attained the age of 18 years & above for the purpose of financial assistance and for Skill Development Training Programme the age limit is 18 years to 45 years.
